headline: Removed Town Manager Shaun Mulholland for cause and appointed Kim Bernard as acting manager for up to 120 days.
summary: Several residents criticized the removal during public comment. The Council also approved a $23,000 purchase of 144 Rear Wildwood Road and a zoning ordinance on 2024 building codes. A community electricity program update reported $893,294 in savings through August 31, 2026.
decisions: Approved removing Town Manager Shaun Mulholland for cause, 3-2-0.
Denied the request to delay the vote on the Town Manager removal.
Approved public release of the legal opinion on the Town Manager removal, 5-0.
Approved Kim Bernard as Acting Town Manager for up to 120 days, 3-2.
Denied the request to delay the vote on the Acting Town Manager appointment.
Approved the $23,000 purchase of 144 Rear Wildwood Road from the Open Space Fund, 5-0.
Approved Ordinance 2026-14 amending sections 9.1 and 9.2 of the Zoning Ordinance, 5-0.
Approved the junkyard license for Grillo Auto Salvage LLC at 55 Hall Road, 4-0 with one recusal.
Continued the School District Office lease agreement to October 5, 2026.
Approved the consent agenda, including an amended tax exemption for PurposeEnergy – Londonderry LLC, 5-0.

Londonderry Town Council Minutes — September 21, 2026 
Page 1 
Londonderry Town Council Meeting Minutes 
Monday, September 21, 2026 | 7:00 p.m. 
Moose Hill Council Chambers, Londonderry Town Hall 
Council Members Present: 
Chair Ron Dunn 
Vice Chair Shawn Faber 
Councilor Dan Bouchard 
Councilor Deb Paul 
Councilor Ted Combes 
Council Members Absent: 
None 
 
Meeting Video Link: 
http://173.166.17.35/internetchannel/show/14328?c
hannel=4 
Other Staff Present: 
Administrative Services Director Kirsten Hildonen 
Town Moderator Jonathan Kipp 
Engineering Dir. John Trottier 
Assistant Bldg. Inspector Brad Anderson 
Minutes Prepared By: 
Kirsten Hildonen using Gemini Notebook AI 
 
A. CALL TO ORDER 
Chair Dunn called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. and led the Pledge of Allegiance. 
Special Presentation & Employee Recognition: Dave Wholley (Director of Public Works) and the 
Town Council recognized John Trottier, PE, Director of Engineering and Environmental Services, 
upon his retirement after 25 years of service on September 25, 2026. Councilor Bouchard read 
Resolution 2026-18 commending Mr. Trottier for his dedicated leadership and public service to 
Londonderry. Mr. Trottier expressed his appreciation to the Council and citizens. 
Special Action Regarding Town Manager: Vice Chair Faber presented a motion to remove Town 
Manager Shaun Mulholland from office for cause pursuant to the Town Charter, citing open 
defiance of Council directives, unauthorized disclosure of attorney-client privileged documents, 
obstruction of an ongoing investigation, unapproved departmental reorganization, failure to 
implement the Council-voted Veterans Tax Credit adjustment, and unauthorized legal 
expenditures. Councilors Paul and Bouchard objected and requested Councilor's Privilege to 
delay the vote. Chair Dunn ruled the request denied as the item pertained to an executive 
personnel matter. 
Vice Chair Faber moved that the Londonderry Town Council hereby removes Shaun Mulholland from 
the position of Town Manager for cause, effective immediately. Seconded by Councilor Combes. Motion 
carried 3-2-0, with Councilors Paul and Bouchard voting in opposition. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
Councilor Bouchard moved to publicly release the written attorney-client privileged legal opinion 
received by the Council regarding the removal of the Town Manager for cause. Seconded by Councilor 
Combes. Motion carried 5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.
Londonderry Town Council Minutes — September 21, 2026 
Page 2 
Chair Dunn recommended appointing former Police Chief Kim Bernard as Acting Town Manager 
for up to 120 days during the transitional period. Councilor Bouchard objected and requested 
Councilor's Privilege to delay the vote. Chair Dunn ruled the request denied as the item pertained 
to a personnel matter. 
Vice Chair Faber moved that the Londonderry Town Council hereby appoints Kim Bernard as Acting 
Town Manager for a term of up to 120 days. Seconded by Councilor Combes. Motion carried 3-2-0, with 
Councilors Paul and Bouchard voting in opposition. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
B. PUBLIC COMMENT 
Election Update: Town Moderator Jonathan Kipp provided a briefing on the recent state primary 
election. He reported smooth operations, strong turnout matching primary numbers from two 
years prior, and noted that one requested recount did not alter the election outcome. Mr. Kipp 
announced that the General Election will take place on November 3, 2026, at the Londonderry 
High School Gymnasium. 
Chair Dunn opened public comment: 
Name: Beth Morocco 
Address: 38 Westwood Drive 
Expressed deep outrage over the sudden removal of Town Manager Shaun Mulholland, stating 
that dismissing an experienced municipal administrator creates severe instability for the 
community. 
Name: Richard Bielinski 
Address: 89 Hall Road 
Addressed Councilor Bouchard regarding comments from the August 17 meeting concerning code 
enforcement issues at 55 Hall Road, asserting that his previous statements regarding non-
compliance were accurate. 
Name: Robin Stewart 
Address: 522 Mammoth Road 
Expressed outrage over the sudden removal of Town Manager Shaun Mulholland, praising his 
municipal qualifications and fiscal discipline in managing town spending. She strongly criticized 
the Council majority's lack of transparency in withholding information from the public and fellow 
councilors, warning that voters would remember their actions in upcoming elections. 
Name: Jan McLaughlin 
Address: 38 Rainbow Drive 
Cited § 5.02 of the Town Charter regarding Councilor's Privilege and stated that proper 
procedure was not followed regarding the Town Manager dismissal as there is no mention of not 
being eligible to be used on personnel matters. 
Name: John Perez 
Address: 5 Wesley Drive 
Expressed strong disappointment in the Council majority's governance and decision-making
Londonderry Town Council Minutes — September 21, 2026 
Page 3 
regarding the dismissal of the Town Manager. Intends to work to see that the Councilors are not 
reelected. 
Chair Dunn closed public comment. 
C. BOARD APPOINTMENTS & REAPPOINTMENTS 
None. 
D. PUBLIC HEARINGS 
1. Receive public input, discuss, and approve the Conservation Commission’s purchase 
of 144 Rear Wildwood Road (Map 003, Lot 099) for the protection of Black Brook 
Conservation Commission Chair Marge Badois and Alternate Member Mike Speltz presented a 
proposal to acquire 144 Rear Wildwood Road (Map 003, Lot 099) from owner Ken Soroco for 
$23,000 using funds from the Open Space Fund. Mr. Speltz explained that acquiring the wetland 
parcel permanently protects Black Brook water quality and continues an established conservation 
corridor. 
Vice Chair Faber moved that the Londonderry Town Council hereby approves the purchase of the 
property located at Map 003, Lot 099 for $23,000 and authorizes the Acting Town Manager to 
execute all documents necessary to effectuate the purchase from the Open Space Fund. Seconded 
by Councilor Combes. Motion carried 5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
Councilor Combes moved to close the public hearing. Seconded by Councilor Bouchard. Motion 
carried 5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
2. Receive public input, discuss, and approve the proposed revisions to the Londonderry 
Zoning Ordinance (LZO) to incorporate the 2024 ICC International Building Codes as 
amended by the State of NH. 
Administrative Services Director Kirsten Hildonen and Chief Building Official Nick Codner 
presented Ordinance 2026-14 to update LZO Sections 9.1 and 9.2, adopting the 2024 
International Code Council (ICC) building codes as mandated by state legislation (HB 1159) while 
streamlining local administrative permitting procedures. 
Councilor Combes moved to open the public hearing. Seconded by Vice Chair Faber. Motion carried 
5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
Chair Dunn asked for public comment; there was none. 
Vice Chair Faber moved that the Londonderry Town Council hereby approves Ordinance 2026-14 
amending sections 9.1 and 9.2 of the Londonderry Zoning Ordinance. Seconded by Councilor 
Combes. Motion carried 5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
Councilor Combes moved to close the public hearing. Seconded by Vice Chair Faber. Motion carried 
5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.
Londonderry Town Council Minutes — September 21, 2026 
Page 4 
E. NEW BUSINESS 
1. Receive a presentation from the Utilities Committee regarding the status of the 
Community Choice Electricity Aggregation Program. 
Utilities Committee Energy Subcommittee Chair Lynn Wiles, committee member Paul Ramsay, 
and Nick Shostak (Freedom Energy Logistics) presented a comprehensive update on the 
Community Choice Aggregation (CCA) Program. Since launching on April 1, 2026, the program 
has achieved over 90% participation (~9,500 enrolled meters), generating $893,294 in cumulative 
savings through August 31, 2026, with forecasted savings reaching $1,692,392 through January 
2027. Mr. Wiles highlighted a newly signed 12-month supply agreement fixed at $0.13523/kWh 
effective November 2026 through October 2027, protecting residents against expected rate 
increases. Informational presentation; no formal Council action required. 
2. Discuss, review and approve the renewal of the Motor Vehicle Junkyard Dealer’s 
Licensing of Junkyard, located at 55 Hall Road, Londonderry, to Grillo Auto Salvage LLC 
pursuant to RSA 236:121. 
Councilor Deb Paul recused herself from this agenda item and stepped away from the bench. 
Assistant Building Inspector Brad Anderson presented the license application for Grillo Auto 
Salvage LLC (owner Joseph Grillo) at 55 Hall Road following the ownership transfer from Murray's 
Auto Recycling (Edward Dudek Jr.). Mr. Anderson confirmed a site inspection on September 15 
showed full compliance with NHDES Best Management Practices and state licensing conditions 
under RSA 236:121. The Council amended the motion title to reflect a new license rather than 
renewal. 
Councilor Bouchard moved that the Londonderry Town Council hereby approves the request of Mr. 
Joseph Grillo for the Junkyard License for Grillo Auto Salvage LLC, located at 55 Hall Road, 
Londonderry, NH. Seconded by Councilor Combes. Motion carried 4-0-0, with Councilor Paul 
recused. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
Councilor Paul rejoined the bench following the vote. 
3. Discuss, approve and authorize the Town Manager to enter into a long-term lease 
agreement in accordance with NH RSA Chapter 53-A for the School District Office 
addition to Town Hall with the Londonderry School District. 
Chair Dunn announced that this agenda item was postponed to the October 5, 2026 meeting to 
allow Acting Town Manager Kim Bernard adequate time to review the proposed intermunicipal 
lease agreement. 
F. OLD BUSINESS 
None.
Londonderry Town Council Minutes — September 21, 2026 
Page 5 
G. APPROVAL OF CONSENT ITEMS 
1. Town Council meeting minutes from September 14, 2026 
2. Municipal Agent Letter appointing Allison Parsons as Municipal Agent effective November 1, 
2026 
3. Amended Resolution 2026-16, Approval of a Commercial / Industrial Property Tax Exemption 
for PurposeEnergy – Londonderry LLC 
4. 2026-09-14 Sewer Abatement ($57.52 plus interest for WGWH Tenants Coop, Inc.) 
Councilor Bouchard moved to approve the consent agenda items as presented. Seconded by Vice 
Chair Faber. Motion carried 5-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative. 
H. OTHER BUSINESS 
1. Liaison Reports 
Councilor Bouchard announced an upcoming public hearing hosted by the Manchester-Boston 
Regional Airport on Wednesday at Londonderry High School regarding the airport's 10-year 
master plan. 
2. Town Manager Report 
None presented due to leadership transition. 
I. PUBLIC COMMENT 
Chair Dunn opened public comment: 
Name: Richard Bielinski 
Address: 89 Hall Road 
Reiterated concerns regarding salvage yard operations at 55 Hall Road, property sales records at 
the Registry of Deeds, and compliance with court orders, stating that the Council has acted in 
error based on inaccurate information and he will continue to pursue this. 
Name: Tony DeFrancesco 
Address: 1 Cheshire Court 
Discussed commercial zoning transfer procedures versus change of use licensing for the junkyard 
and stated that there should have been a public hearing. He provided input on the municipal tax 
incentive program discussed at the prior meeting to show that the tax revenue will increase and 
that there is a low demand for service.  
Name: Sandra Lagueux 
Address: 2 Fiddlers Ridge Road 
Expressed severe disappointment regarding the removal of Town Manager Shaun Mulholland, 
citing undue influence outside the Council and reviewed the Charter provisions under § 5.02 
about the removal of the Town Manager.
Londonderry Town Council Minutes — September 21, 2026 
Page 6 
Name: Paul Margolin 
Address: 35 King Arthur Drive 
Expressed opposition to the Council majority's action and called for upholding town governance 
standards. 
Chair Dunn closed public comment. 
J. NON-PUBLIC SESSION 
None held. 
K. ADJOURNMENT 
Vice Chair Faber moved to adjourn the meeting. Seconded by Councilor Combes. Motion carried 5-
0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative. The meeting adjourned at 9:45 p.m. 
L. MEETING SCHEDULE 
• October 5, 2026; Moose Hill Council Chambers; 7:00 p.m. 
• October 19, 2026; Moose Hill Council Chambers; 7:00 p.m.
